name: MAC Plastics Manufacturing,Inc.
old_description: Our customer service includes quality engineering & production, but also finding solutions to other customer needs such as timing, packaging and warehousing.
about:
MAC Plastics Manufacturing, Inc. is headquartered in Olney, Illinois, with a second production facility in Hamilton, Indiana added in 2022. The company was founded by Rod Michels, Aaron Ackman, and Brian Craig, drawing on over 75 years of combined plastics experience among its leadership. In 2019, an ownership group acquired the business, maintaining a family-oriented culture focused on custom manufacturing and dependable delivery.

The company produces custom plastic extrusions, co-extrusions, injection molded parts, tooling, fabrication, finishing, and assemblies. Operations span two Midwest facilities totaling over 100,000 square feet, equipped with 20 extrusion lines, six co-extrusion lines, and three injection molding machines. Inline capabilities include punching, cutting, notching, drilling, boring, chamfering, and printing; offline secondary operations cover CNC routing, custom packaging, assembly, and warehousing. Engineering support, 3D-printed prototyping, and testing to ASTM and IAPMO standards round out the production depth.

MAC serves OEMs, distributors, public utilities, and industrial buyers across aerospace, defense, agriculture, marine and pool, lawn and garden, telecommunications, construction, industrial manufacturing, transportation, sanitation, utilities, and energy sectors. A noted specialty is co-extruded rigid and flexible trailing shields for the walk-behind mower industry.

The company emphasizes lean production discipline, in-house tooling, and practical engineering to deliver parts built to customer drawings rather than off-the-shelf. Leadership cites a team-driven culture of continuous improvement, competitive positioning, and attention to timing, packaging, and real-world fit as core differentiators.
